raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "orix" %}
{% set version = "0.14.3" %}
{% set python_min = "3.10" %}

package:
  name: {{ name }}-meta
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9e15e7a30d8ba97d311138b2caf321d8492cdbb9325dc7061e7a8c06a91d8e42

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}

outputs:
  - name: {{ name }}-base
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv
    requirements:
      host:
        - python {{ python_min }}
        - hatchling
        - pip
      run:
        - python >={{ python_min }}
        - dask-core
        - diffpy.structure >=3.0.2
        - h5py
        - lazy-loader
        - matplotlib-base >=3.6.1
        - numba
        - numpy
        - pooch >=0.13
        # TODO: Remove when https://github.com/pyxem/orix/issues/510 is fixed
        - pycifrw
        - scipy
        - tqdm
        - typing-extensions
    test:
      requires:
        - python {{ python_min }}
        - pip
        - pytest
        - pytest-xdist
        - pytest-rerunfailures
      imports:
        - orix
        - orix.crystal_map
        - orix.data
        - orix.io
        - orix.measure
        - orix.plot
        - orix.projections
        - orix.quaternion
        - orix.sampling
        - orix.vector
      commands:
        - python -m pip check
        - export MPLBACKEND=agg
        - python -m pytest -vvv -n 2 --reruns 2 --pyargs orix

  - name: {{ name }}
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python {{ python_min }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('orix-base', exact=True) }}
        - matplotlib-scalebar
        - quaternion
    test:
      requires:
        - python {{ python_min }}
        - pip
        - pytest
        - pytest-xdist
        - pytest-rerunfailures
      imports:
        - orix
        - orix.crystal_map
        - orix.data
        - orix.io
        - orix.measure
        - orix.plot
        - orix.projections
        - orix.quaternion
        - orix.sampling
        - orix.vector
      commands:
        - export MPLBACKEND=agg
        - python -m pytest -vvv -n 2 --reruns 2 --pyargs orix

about:
  home: https://orix.readthedocs.io
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_family: GPL
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: |
    Python library for handling of crystal orientation mapping data
  description: |
    orix defines objects and functions for the analysis of orientations
    represented as quaternions or 3D rotation vectors accounting for crystal
    symmetry. Functionality builds primarily on NumPy and Matplotlib.
  dev_url: https://github.com/pyxem/orix
  doc_url: https://orix.readthedocs.io/en/stable

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - argerlt
    - dnjohnstone
    - pc494
    - hakonanes
    - harripj
